title: Sick Room High-Fever Digital Register
problem: Students resting in the hostel sick room lie for hours without temperature tracking, because fever readings stay recorded in handwritten paper logs.
idea: A digital fever register. The health captain types the thermometer reading and the screen turns red for high fever so the warden acts fast. Try it with a reading.

widgets.heading: 🌡️ Enter the thermometer reading
widgets.intro: Use a digital thermometer. Choose °F or °C.
widgets.formula: if (typeof temp !== 'number' || typeof hours !== 'number') return null; var f = unit === 'C' ? temp * 9 / 5 + 32 : temp; if (f < 90 || f > 110) return null; var msg, level; if (f >= 103) { msg = '🔴 VERY HIGH FEVER. Tell the warden NOW. Call 108 or go to the PHC.'; level = 'bad'; } else if (f >= 100.4) { msg = '🔴 FEVER. Show to the nurse / PHC doctor. Check again every 2 hours.'; level = 'bad'; } else if (f >= 99.1) { msg = '🟡 Slightly warm. Rest, drink water, check again in 2 hours.'; level = 'warn'; } else { msg = '🟢 Normal temperature.'; level = 'good'; } if (f >= 100.4 && hours >= 48) msg += ' Fever for 2+ days: must see a doctor today.'; return {f: f, msg: msg, level: level};

items.text: Wrote the name, time and temperature.
Gave the student clean drinking water.
Told the warden about any reading of 100.4 °F or more.
Checked for danger signs: fits, very sleepy, breathing trouble, rash.
items.te: ప్రమాద సంకేతాలు చూశాను: ఫిట్స్, మగత, ఊపిరి ఇబ్బంది, దద్దుర్లు.

bands.text: Please follow every step. A sick friend needs you.

items.title: Call 108
items.text: For very high fever, fits or breathing trouble, call 108 ambulance.
items.te: ఎక్కువ జ్వరం, ఫిట్స్, ఊపిరి ఇబ్బందికి 108కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

items.title: Go to the PHC
items.text: Fever of 100.4 °F or more should be checked by the nurse or PHC doctor.
items.te: 100.4 °F పైన జ్వరం ఉంటే నర్స్ లేదా PHC డాక్టర్‌కి చూపించండి.

items.title: No self medicine
items.text: Students should not take tablets on their own. Only the nurse or doctor gives medicine.
items.te: సొంతంగా మాత్రలు వేసుకోవద్దు. నర్స్ లేదా డాక్టర్ మాత్రమే ఇవ్వాలి.

how: In Scratch, make two lists: 'Name' and 'Temperature', and a variable for time.
Add an 'ask' block: 'Enter student name' and 'Enter temperature'.
Use 'if temperature ≥ 100.4 then' to change the backdrop to bright red and play a beep.
Use 'if temperature ≥ 103' to show 'Call warden now — 108'.
Show the full list on screen so the warden can see everyone at one look.
Ask Gemini for the danger signs of fever in simple Telugu and add them to the screen.
prompt: I am a Class 8 health captain in a hostel. In simple English and Telugu, tell me which body temperatures are normal, fever and very high fever (in °F), and list 5 danger signs when we must call 108 or take the student to the PHC.
